notes.title: First public appearance of Wonderfall at gamescom!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello curious mind,[/h2][p][/p][p]An ancient world is awakening… and you’re among the first to hear its echoes.
[/p][p]We’re excited to share that [b]Wonderfall[/b] will make its [b]public debut at gamescom 2025[/b]!
It’ll be your very first chance to experience the game hands-on, through an exclusive playable version.[/p][p][/p][p]But this is just a glimpse.
A [b]more complete demo will be available on Steam this fall[/b], during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]Add [b]Wonderfall[/b] to your [b]wishlist[/b] so you don’t miss the moment the gates open.[/p][p][/p][p]Léon is waiting...[/p][p]Stay tuned.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455827/ee86c3fa2324937dc1648959a138a4e3ae3d9b41.png"][/img][/p]
